component.title: ConflictResolutionFlow
component.purpose: ConflictResolutionFlow makes concurrent edits explicit, field-resolvable, and recoverable without discarding local intent.

states.description: Local and remote values are visible with an explicit choice.
The comparison remains stable while the latest version is checked.
Resolution submission is announced and controls remain stable.
Successful resolution is announced without hiding the saved outcome.
A failed retry preserves all selected choices.
The user can retry without reconstructing the decision.

claims.statement: Every conflict field exposes local and remote values with native keyboard-operable choices.
Request failure preserves the user's choices and provides an explicit retry path.
